mapper.sql: t.user_id=#{userId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status='ACTIVE'
transcript t JOIN media m ON m.id=t.media_id AND m.user_id=t.user_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM WHERE AND t.media_id=#{mediaId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t.* FROM WHERE AND t.id=#{id}
SELECT t.* FROM WHERE AND t.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM media_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND media_id=#{mediaId} AND kind='TRANSCRIPTION' AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','CANCELLING') AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE transcript SET version=#{version},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS transcript_id,1 AS version FROM WHERE AND t.source_task_id=#{taskId}
